description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 4330015399309 SERVICE KIT,CENTRIF: Line 0001 Qty 52 UI KT Deliver To: By: 0189 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
